# TDZ Distribution

> Creator-first streaming platform paying artists $1 per qualified stream. Upload, distribute, stream, and monetize music with built-in AI tools.

TDZ is a standalone music streaming and distribution platform. Artists upload music, fans subscribe to listen, and qualified streams pay artists $1 each (playback over 30 seconds or 50% of a track, by an active paid subscriber, with the tab focused — no self-plays). The platform includes an Artist Studio with AI-powered campaigns, analytics, and release tools, plus a fan Discovery experience with playlists, social features, and live listening.

- [Pricing](/pricing): Artist plans (Starter $10, Pro $20, Enterprise $50) and Fan $12 subscription.

- [Investors](/investors): Investor deck — $10M Series Seed at 15%, traction, and market.

- [Support](/support): Help with uploads, payouts, account, and platform features.
